formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : SimpleGraph (Fin x1)) (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∃ (x4 : Fin x1) (x5 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x4 x5) → (∀ (x5 x6 x7 x8 : Fin x1), x5 ≠ x6 → x5 ≠ x7 → x5 ≠ x8 → x6 ≠ x7 → x6 ≠ x8 → x7 ≠ x8 → x2.Adj x5 x6 → x2.Adj x6 x7 → x2.Adj x7 x8 → ¬x2.Adj x8 x5) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x3 → (∀ (x7 : Fin x1 → Bool), x3.eval (List.ofFn x7) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x8 : Fin x1) (x9 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x8 x9 ∧ x7 x8 = Bool.true ∧ x7 x9 = Bool.true) → ∃ (x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x8 ∧ (∀ (x9 : Fin x1 → Bool), x8.eval (List.ofFn x9) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x10 : Fin x1) (x11 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x10 x11 ∧ x9 x10 = Bool.true ∧ x9 x11 = Bool.true) ∧ x8.size ≤ x3.size ∧ ∀ (x9 : ℕ) (x10 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x8.gates[x9]? = Option.some x10 → x10.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∀ (x13 : Fin x1 → Bool), (x8.wires (List.ofFn x13)).getD (x1 + x9) Bool.false = Bool.true → ∃ (x15 : Fin x1) (x16 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x15 x16 ∧ x13 x15 = Bool.true ∧ x13 x16 = Bool.true
plain_statement: A graph with an edge and no 4-cycle. Every circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, for its edge function has an equal circuit of that kind, no larger, in which every AND gate is true only at inputs where the function is true.
title: A step toward: A step toward: Graphs without a 4-cycle: every circuit of AND and OR gates for the edge function has at least |E| + tau - 1 gates
